channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-68820 — Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

item.title: CVE-2026-41091 — Microsoft Defender
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Microsoft Defender contains a link following vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

item.title: CVE-2026-20122 — Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manger
item.description: Threat Signal 58. Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability due to improper file handling on the API interface of an affected system. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by uploading a malicious file on the local file system. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to overwrite arbitrary files on the affected system and gain vmanage user privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-63077 — JetBrains TeamCity
item.description: Threat Signal 76. JetBrains TeamCity contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution via the agent polling protocol.

item.title: CVE-2010-0806 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains an use-after-free vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via vectors involving access to an invalid pointer after the deletion of an object. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2025-64328 — Sangoma FreePBX
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Sangoma FreePBX Endpoint Manager contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow for a post-authentication command injection by an authenticated known user via the testconnection -> check_ssh_connect() function. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to potentially obtain remote access to the system as an asterisk user.

item.title: CVE-2025-34026 — Versa Concerto
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Versa Concerto SD-WAN orchestration platform contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the Traefik reverse proxy configuration, allowing at attacker to access administrative endpoints. The internal Actuator endpoint can be leveraged for access to heap dumps and trace logs.

item.title: CVE-2025-8110 — Gogs Gogs
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Gogs contains a path traversal vulnerability affecting improper Symbolic link handling in the PutContents API that could allow for code execution.

item.title: CVE-2025-14847 — MongoDB MongoDB and MongoDB Server
item.description: Threat Signal 76. MongoDB Server contains an improper handling of length parameter inconsistency vulnerability in Zlib compressed protocol headers. This vulnerability may allow a read of uninitialized heap memory by an unauthenticated client.

item.title: CVE-2025-14733 — WatchGuard Firebox
item.description: Threat Signal 76. WatchGuard Fireware OS iked process contains an out of bounds write vulnerability in the OS iked process. This vulnerability may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code and affects both the mobile user VPN with IKEv2 and the branch office VPN using IKEv2 when configured with a dynamic gateway peer.

item.title: CVE-2025-59718 — Fortinet Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Fortinet FortiOS, FortiSwitchMaster, FortiProxy, and FortiWeb contain an improper verification of cryptographic signature vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass the FortiCloud SSO login authentication via a crafted SAML message. Please be aware that CVE-2025-59719 pertains to the same problem and is mentioned in the same vendor advisory. Ensure to apply all patches mentioned in the advisory.

item.title: CVE-2025-6218 — RARLAB WinRAR
item.description: Threat Signal 76. RARLAB WinRAR contains a path traversal vulnerability allowing an attacker to execute code in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2011-3402 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Microsoft Windows Kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability in the TrueType font parsing engine in win32k.sys in the kernel-mode drivers that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted font data in a Word document or web page.

item.title: CVE-2021-21311 — Adminer Adminer
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Adminer contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that, when exploited, allows a remote attacker to obtain potentially sensitive information.

item.title: CVE-2013-3893 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2024-42009 — Roundcube Webmail
item.description: Threat Signal 76. RoundCube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow a remote attacker to steal and send emails of a victim via a crafted e-mail message that abuses a Desanitization issue in message_body() in program/actions/mail/show.php.

item.title: CVE-2024-48248 — NAKIVO Backup and Replication
item.description: Threat Signal 76. NAKIVO Backup and Replication contains an absolute path traversal vulnerability that enables an attacker to read arbitrary files.

item.title: CVE-2016-3714 — ImageMagick ImageMagick
item.description: Threat Signal 76. ImageMagick contains an improper input validation vulnerability that affects the EPHEMERAL, HTTPS, MVG, MSL, TEXT, SHOW, WIN, and PLT coders. This allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via shell metacharacters in a crafted image.

item.title: CVE-2023-36025 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Microsoft Windows SmartScreen contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that could allow an attacker to bypass Windows Defender SmartScreen checks and their associated prompts.

item.title: CVE-2023-28252 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2023-26360 — Adobe ColdFusion
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Adobe ColdFusion contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-44698 — Microsoft Defender
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Microsoft Defender SmartScreen contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that could allow an attacker to evade Mark of the Web (MOTW) defenses via a specially crafted malicious file.

item.title: CVE-2018-19949 — QNAP Network Attached Storage (NAS)
item.description: Threat Signal 76. A command injection vulnerability affecting QNAP NAS File Station could allow remote attackers to run commands.

item.title: CVE-2016-6366 — Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA)
item.description: Threat Signal 76. A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) code of Cisco ASA software could allow an attacker to cause a reload of the affected system or to remotely execute code.

item.title: CVE-2018-20753 — Kaseya Virtual System/Server Administrator (VSA)
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Kaseya VSA RMM allows unprivileged remote attackers to execute PowerShell payloads on all managed devices.

item.title: CVE-2021-3156 — Sudo Sudo
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Sudo contains an off-by-one error that can result in a heap-based buffer overflow, which allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2021-20028 — SonicWall Secure Remote Access (SRA)
item.description: Threat Signal 76. SonicWall Secure Remote Access (SRA) products contain an improper neutralization of a SQL Command leading to SQL injection.

item.title: CVE-2022-26318 — WatchGuard Firebox and XTM Appliances
item.description: Threat Signal 76. On WatchGuard Firebox and XTM appliances, an unauthenticated user can execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2017-12617 — Apache Tomcat
item.description: Threat Signal 76. When running Apache Tomcat, it is possible to upload a JSP file to the server via a specially crafted request. This JSP could then be requested and any code it contained would be executed by the server.

item.title: CVE-2013-4810 — Hewlett Packard (HP) ProCurve Manager (PCM), PCM+, Identity Driven Manager (IDM), and Application Lifecycle Management
item.description: Threat Signal 76. HP ProCurve Manager (PCM), PCM+, Identity Driven Manager (IDM), and Application Lifecycle Management allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a marshalled object to (1) EJBInvokerServlet or (2) JMXInvokerServlet.

item.title: CVE-2013-3346 — Adobe Reader and Acrobat
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Adobe Reader and Acrobat contain a memory corruption vulnerability which can allow attackers to execute arbitrary code or cause a denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2017-8464 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Windows Shell in multiple versions of Microsoft Windows allows local users or remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted .LNK file

item.title: CVE-2021-32648 — October CMS October CMS
item.description: Threat Signal 76. In affected versions of the october/system package an attacker can request an account password reset and then gain access to the account using a specially crafted request.

item.title: CVE-2021-22204 — Perl Exiftool
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Improper neutralization of user data in the DjVu file format in Exiftool versions 7.44 and up allows arbitrary code execution when parsing the malicious image

item.title: CVE-2017-9805 — Apache Struts
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Apache Struts REST Plugin uses an XStreamHandler with an instance of XStream for deserialization without any type filtering, which can lead to remote code execution when deserializing XML payloads.

item.title: CVE-2018-11776 — Apache Struts
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Apache Struts contains a vulnerability that allows for remote code execution under two circumstances. One, where the alwaysSelectFullNamespace option is true and the value isn't set for a result defined in underlying configurations and in same time, its upper package configuration have no or wildcard namespace. Or, using URL tag which doesn't have value and action set and in same time, its upper package configuration have no or wildcard namespace.

item.title: CVE-2020-14871 — Oracle Solaris and Zettabyte File System (ZFS)
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Oracle Solaris and Oracle ZFS Storage Appliance Kit contain an unspecified vulnerability causing high impacts to confidentiality, integrity, and availability of affected systems.

item.title: CVE-2020-10987 — Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute system commands via the deviceName POST parameter.

item.title: CVE-2026-85046 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2026-59310 — Broadcom VMware vCenter
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Broadcom VMware vCenter contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a threat actor with network access to vCenter to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2025-62593 — Ray-Project Ray
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Ray-Project Ray contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow remote code execution. Developers using Ray as a development tool may be exposed to this vulnerability exploitable through Firefox and Safari.

item.title: CVE-2026-15409 — SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances
item.description: Threat Signal 75. SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contain a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to potentially cause the appliance to make requests to unintended location.

item.title: CVE-2026-1603 — Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM)
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to leak specific stored credential data.

item.title: CVE-2021-22681 — Rockwell Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Multiple Rockwell products contain an insufficient protected credentials vulnerability. Studio 5000 Logix Designer software may allow a key to be discovered. This key is used to verify Logix controllers are communicating with Rockwell Automation design software. If successfully exploited, this vulnerability could allow an unauthorized application to connect with Logix controllers. To leverage this vulnerability, an unauthorized user would require network access to the controller.

item.title: CVE-2008-0015 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft Windows Video ActiveX Control contains a remote code execution vulnerability. An attacker could exploit the vulnerability by constructing a specially crafted Web page. When a user views the Web page, the vulnerability could allow remote code execution. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could gain the same user rights as the logged-on user.

item.title: CVE-2025-11371 — Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox contains a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability that allows unintended disclosure of system files.

item.title: CVE-2025-6205 — Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Dassault Systèmes DELMIA Apriso contains a missing authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain privileged access to the application.

item.title: CVE-2021-43798 — Grafana Labs Grafana
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Grafana contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow access to local files.

item.title: CVE-2013-3918 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft Windows contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the InformationCardSigninHelper Class ActiveX control, icardie.dll. An attacker could exploit the vulnerability by constructing a specially crafted webpage. When a user views the webpage, the vulnerability could allow remote code execution. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could gain the same user rights as the current user. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2020-25078 — D-Link DCS-2530L and DCS-2670L Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 75. D-Link DCS-2530L and DCS-2670L devices contains an unspecified vulnerability that could allow for remote administrator password disclosure. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.
